# Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all() or (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite nonpositive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")

    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    # Compute weights
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(future_horizon))
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute losses (negative weighted log probabilities)
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
